name: Feature request
about: Something Software City could do that it doesn't.
title: "[feature] "
labels: ["enhancement"]

---

## What you'd like

A short description. The user-visible effect matters most; the implementation is up to the maintainer.

## Why

What's the problem this would solve? Who runs into it, in what context?

## Sketch

A wireframe, a screen recording, a paragraph describing the interaction. The closest existing thing in Software City is fine.

## Constraints

- Privacy: nothing should leak the user's code off their machine.
- Offline: the app should still work after first load with the network off.
- Mobile: any new interaction should work in a phone browser.
